scripts.dev: npm run prepare:ffmpeg -- --optional && npm run prepare:omt -- --optional && npm run prepare:version && tauri dev --config tauri.local-version.json
scripts.build: npm run prepare:ffmpeg && npm run prepare:omt && npm run prepare:version && tauri build --config tauri.local-version.json
scripts.build:release: npm run prepare:ffmpeg -- --release --force && npm run prepare:omt -- --release --force && tauri build
scripts.build:release:macos: npm run prepare:ffmpeg -- --release --force && npm run prepare:omt -- --release --force && tauri build --bundles dmg && scripts/hide-macos-dmg-app-extension.sh
scripts.build:release:windows: npm run prepare:ffmpeg -- --release --force && npm run prepare:omt -- --release --force && tauri build --bundles nsis
